## Professional experience

- Sowlutions — Front-End Developer, January 2025–August 2026. Hands-on frontend
  delivery across SaaS, AI, analytics, creator-economy, and client platforms.
  Responsibilities included implementation, pull-request reviews, release
  coordination, API planning, reusable Nuxt foundations, and developer onboarding.
- Axentech GIB — Front-End Developer, December 2023–September 2024. Production
  React features for an insurance-brokerage ERP, including clients, invoices,
  receipts, installment tracking, complex forms, data tables, and REST APIs.

## Selected projects

- [Auraflow](https://rachida.dev/projects/auraflow): Interactive WebGL wallpaper
  studio with six creative modes, local presets, and PNG exports.
- [Next Template](https://rachida.dev/projects/next-template): Independent Next.js,
  PocketBase, and Expo foundations with typed contracts and recovery-ready deployment.
- [All projects](https://rachida.dev/projects): The current project collection.

## Engineering approach

Clear architecture, reusable interface patterns, accessible controls, responsive
layouts, reliable states, and graceful fallbacks. Animation supports hierarchy
and context. The portfolio serves readable HTML independently of its optional
WebGL effects; structured profile data is included on the home page.
